title: Comparing Algorithm Efficiency
definition: Comparing algorithms requires understanding trade-offs. Often, we can trade Space for Time (e.g., using a Hash Map uses O(N) space but drops lookup time from O(N) to O(1)).
simpleExplanation: Do you want it done fast (uses more memory) or do you want it to use less memory (takes longer)?

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Complexity Tradeoffs.
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Complexity Tradeoffs to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Complexity Tradeoffs (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Complexity Tradeoffs for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Complexity Tradeoffs in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
